It is background/technique: no QOU quantity is computed from it, and 'matrix dilogarithm' appears nowhere in the corpus (0 hits), so nothing here is currently load-bearing. Registering it would give the quantum-Bloch-group cluster a proper framework citation instead of only Kashaev/Faddeev primary sources.

relevance.rationale: Constructs quantum hyperbolic field theories indexed by odd N: (2+1)-dimensional theories assigning to a marked bordism with a framed tangle and a PSL(2,C)-character a tensor built out of matrix dilogarithms, holomorphic in the boundary parameters, with surgery formulas for the partition functions. At N = 1 the tensors are scalars and coincide with the Cheeger-Chern-Simons invariants of PSL(2,C)-characters on closed or cusped hyperbolic manifolds. This is the foundational construction underlying library/4geo-dedi-rev/4GEO-DEDI-REV.pdf in the same slice. Supporting: the folio has no reference at all for quantum hyperbolic geometry despite working the odd-root-of-unity state-sum face, and the N = 1 to Cheeger-Chern-Simons reduction is the literature statement nearest to the corpus's complex-volume observable -- but no corpus derivation consumes a QHFT theorem, and the corpus computes no bordism partition functions.

keyResults.statement: At N = 1 the QHFT tensors are scalar-valued and coincide with the Cheeger-Chern-Simons invariants of PSL(2,C)-characters on closed manifolds and cusped hyperbolic manifolds.
keyResults.useForFolio: Places the corpus's fraktur-V = Vol + i CS observable in a family whose N > 1 members are the root-of-unity state sums the folio's Faddeev face uses, i.e. an explicit statement that the classical complex volume is the N = 1 member of the quantum tower. Relevant to conj:borromean-bloch-group-element, whose regulator claim is a Cheeger-Chern-Simons-class statement.
